input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalties, or stipulated-sum charges payable by Client appear anywhere in the Agreement. Searches for "liquidated damages," "penalt," "damages," and "shall pay" return nothing, and the spamming provisions (§ 7 and § 8f) impose only conduct restrictions and technical/equitable remedies rather than per-message or fixed monetary charges. The only Client-payable amounts are ordinary fees under § 5(a), including uncontestable minimum monthly fees, which are consideration for services actually delivered rather than damages. Termination under § 14 carries no early-termination fee; Client's exposure is limited to continued fees through the last day of the month following its notice (roughly one to two months), which is within the playbook's 3-month fallback in any event. Direction check confirms no Customer-payable LD exists, so the rule is satisfied and no redline is warranted.
